title: Animated market opening on the home screen
problem: The home scene is a harbour that the sign card mostly covers; the owner asked for an animated fruit market when the link opens (prototype: Market_Opening_Prototype.html).
scope: Replace the harbour with a pixel market street loop: lorry arrives, fruit goes to stalls, customers order and pay, lorry leaves
CSS-only motion, stepped like the rest of the game, no sound
The title and buttons stay usable from the first moment (nothing waits for the animation)
exclusions: A longer intro or a forced splash

acceptance.text: The home screen opens within the existing performance budget (perf-budget script)
With reduced motion the scene shows a still frame and nothing moves
Buttons are usable immediately and the scene never covers them
The scene looks right on a phone and a wide screen
Lint, types, unit tests, build and browser tests pass
